text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to the beach with Vivlos for a magazine photo shoot.
As for why the beach—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because, because!
I reaaally wanted to get a picture taken
with the beautiful sea and desert-like beach!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Thanks for bringing me along,
Trainy♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you as well, Mr. Cameraman.
Make sure to make me look cute, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Let's take some great photos!

The photoshoot went smoothly.
Her racing silks strangely seemed
to blend right in with the scenery.
choice_data_list: Blue really suits you, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?
It's the same color as my big sisters'!

If I recall, her older sisters—
Verxina and Cheval Grand—also incorporate
beautiful blue color schemes into their racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you see, they all have different meanings.
My blue is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The blue skies and blue sea of Dubai! That's why I wanted you to take photos by the sea!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And you know, actually, there's one more thing
I have that matches with big sis.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: These golden earrings match too ♡
choice_data_list: Is there a meaning behind your earrings?
Is there a special meaning behind your earring?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's still a secret~♪

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: That expression right now is great! One more!

Frolicking along the water's edge and darting across the sandy beach,
Vilbros looked just like a lively desert princess.

The entire photoshoot wrapped up without a hitch.
The sky turned to shades of crimson and purple, with sunset not far off.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there!
I'll send over the article at a later date, so—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me! Could we please continue filming for just a li~ttle bit longer...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I want to capture the color of this sky!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's the magic hour.
The time of day when you can take magical photos.
Yes... wonderful, let's take one!"
choice_data_list: Well then, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to it~!

A complete shift from how she is by day,
Vivlos complies with the photoshoot in a calm, quiet mood.

The beach looks like a desert, the ocean like an endless southern sea,
and Vilbros's golden hair ornament sparkles magically,
reflecting the light of twilight.
choice_data_list: (I feel like I've seen this scene somewhere before...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look look, Trainy!
It's a photo from the first time I went to Dubai!
I took it from the airplane! Pretty, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It was right when the sun was setting into the desert,
and Dubai's already beautiful skyscrapers started glittering and shining—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It looked just like a fairy castle
with a golden star sitting right on top!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's just like a magical kingdom!

Vilbros surely wanted to capture
Dubai's magical sparkle in her own racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Good work!
I got some incredible shots.
I can't wait to see the readers' reactions.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it too~♡
Mr. Photographer, thank you so much
for granting all of my requests!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trainy, how was my shoot?
choice_data_list: You shone just as brightly as Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Ehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, so, which me does Trainy prefer,
daytime or evening?
choice_data_list: In the bright light of day, she looked just like a princess
The evening had a mysterious air to it, huh.
The evening was pretty mysterious, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, so, which me does Trainy prefer,
daytime or evening?
choice_data_list: In the bright light of day, she looked just like a princess
The evening had a mysterious air to it, huh.
The evening was pretty mysterious, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A princess?!
That's super high-class!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, Trainy, you're always
so good at flattering me~!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then let's come back around noon sometime.
I'll show you an even more gorgeous and glamorous me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Dubai is super gorgeous,
and so mysterious too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I incorporated that kind of Dubai vibe into my racing outfit too.
Look, I was super particular about this earring~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Not flashy-flashy!
More like sparkly-sparkle~♪ so I can shine bright!
